```{r}
#| label: setup

library(dplyr)
library(arrow)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(tidylog)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pointblank)

data_dir <- here::here("inputs/")
mar_dir <- paste0(data_dir, "/2026-03-11/")
aug_dir <- paste0(data_dir, "/2026-08-07/")

```

# Arrests

```{r}

# ---- Read in files ----

col_types_mar <- c(
  "date", # Apprehension Date
  "text", # Apprehension Type
  "text", # State
  "text", # County
  "text", # TOA Current Duty AOR
  "text", # Apprehension Final Program
  "text", # Arresting Agency
  "text", # Apprehension Method
  "text", # Apprehension Criminality
  "text", # Case Status
  "text", # Case Category
  "text", # Departure Country
  "text", # Final Order Yes No
  "text", # Birth Date
  "numeric", # Birth Year
  "text", # Citizenship Country
  "text", # Gender
  "date", # Departed Date
  "date", # Final Order Date
  "text", # Apprehension Site Landmark
  "text", # Operation
  "text", # TOA Current Duty Site
  "text", # Case Criminality
  "text", # Case Threat Level
  "text" # Anonymized Identifier
)

col_types_aug <- c(
  "text", # AOR
  "text", # County
  "text", # Apprehension Criminality
  "date", # Apprehension Date
  "text", # Event Landmark
  "text", # Apprehension Method
  "text", # State
  "text", # City
  "numeric", # Birth Year
  "text", # Case Category
  "text", # Case Status
  "text", # Case Threat Level
  "text", # Citizenship Country
  "date", # Departed Date
  "text", # Departure Country
  "date", # Final Order Date
  "text", # Final Order Yes No
  "text", # Final Program
  "text", # Final Program Group
  "text", # Gender
  "text", # Alien File Number
  "text" # Anonymized Unique Identifier
)

# FY24 file lacks Alien File Number column
col_types_fy24 <- col_types_aug[-21]

arrests_df_aug <-
  list.files(
    aug_dir,
    pattern = "^[^~].*ARS",
    full.names = TRUE
  ) |>
  set_names(basename) |>
  map_dfr(
    function(f) {
      # FY24 file lacks Alien File Number column
      n_cols <- ncol(readxl::read_excel(f, n_max = 0, skip = 6))
      ct <- if (n_cols == length(col_types_aug)) {
        col_types_aug
      } else {
        col_types_fy24
      }
      readxl::excel_sheets(f) |>
        set_names() |>
        map_dfr(
          function(s) {
            readxl::read_excel(
              path = f,
              sheet = s,
              col_types = ct,
              skip = 6
            )
          },
          .id = "sheet_original"
        )
    },
    .id = "file_original"
  )

arrests_df_mar <-
  list.files(
    mar_dir,
    pattern = "^[^~].*Arrests",
    full.names = TRUE
  ) |>
  set_names(basename) |>
  map_dfr(
    function(f) {
      readxl::excel_sheets(f) |>
        set_names() |>
        map_dfr(
          function(s) {
            readxl::read_excel(
              path = f,
              sheet = s,
              col_types = col_types_mar,
              skip = 6
            )
          },
          .id = "sheet_original"
        )
    },
    .id = "file_original"
  )

# ---- Check: read ----
arrests_df_aug |>
  col_exists(
    c(`Apprehension Date`, `Anonymized Unique Identifier`, `Gender`, `Case Status`)
  ) |>
  col_vals_not_null(
    `Apprehension Date`,
    actions = action_levels(warn_at = 0.01, stop_at = 0.05)
  ) |>
  invisible()

arrests_df_mar |>
  col_exists(
    c(`Apprehension Date`, `Anonymized Identifier`, `Gender`, `Case Status`)
  ) |>
  col_vals_not_null(
    `Apprehension Date`,
    actions = action_levels(warn_at = 0.01, stop_at = 0.05)
  ) |>
  invisible()

```

## Naive cleaning
```{r}

arrests_df_mar <- arrests_df_mar |> 
    janitor::clean_names()

arrests_df_aug <- arrests_df_aug |> 
    janitor::clean_names()

```


## Weekly counts

```{r}

dat_mar <- arrests_df_mar |> 
    mutate(week = floor_date(apprehension_date, unit="weeks")) |> 
    count(week) |> 
    mutate(source = "2026-03 release")

dat_aug <- arrests_df_aug |> 
    mutate(week = floor_date(apprehension_date, unit="weeks")) |> 
    count(week) |> 
    mutate(source = "2026-08 release")

dat <- rbind(dat_mar, dat_aug)

p1 <- dat |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = week, y = n, color = source, group = source)) +
    geom_line() + theme_minimal()

p1

```
